steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Arrays: contiguous, O(1) access; Lists: dynamic, O(1) append amortised; Stacks: LIFO, push/pop; Queues: FIFO, enqueue/dequeue

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Linked lists: singly/doubly, O(1) insert/delete at known position, O(n) access

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Trees: binary, BST (left<root<right), AVL/Red-Black (balanced); traversals: pre/in/post-order, level-order

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Graphs: adjacency matrix/list; directed/undirected, weighted/unweighted; BFS/DFS

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Trace quicksort on [3, 6, 8, 10, 1, 2, 1] with pivot as first element --- Solution: Pivot=3. Partition: [1,2,1] + [3] + [6,8,10]. Recurse left: pivot=1 -> [1] + [1] + [2]. Right: pivot=6 -> [] + [6] + [8,10] -> pivot=8 -> [] + [8] + [10]. Result: [1,1,2,3,6,8,10]
